title: SOC2 daily scratchpad - vendor reviews & evidence
content:
Quick morning scratchpad for SOC2 tasks and vendor reviews. Mostly personal notes, checkboxes, and links to evidence.

Today focus:
- [ ] Finalize vendor questionnaire for LogStream (need legal + infra sign-off) - target: EOD 2026-03-05
- [x] Upload access-control screenshots for SSO (Okta) to evidence folder (uploaded 2026-03-03)
- [ ] Follow up with Maya on firewall rule docs (CONFLUENCE-SEC-FW) - blocked by infra changes
- [ ] Draft answer for auditor question re: backup retention policy (see backup-policy-draft below)

Notes / context:
- Vendor: LogStream (security questionnaire received 2026-03-02). Key open items: encryption-in-transit details, key rotation cadence, SOC2 attestation date. Legal wants the data flow diagram before we send answers. Action: request diagram from vendor; if not available, ask infra to draft a minimal flow.
- Evidence upload checklist: screenshots should include timestamps, username, and system timezone. Use the screenshot template in Confluence (link below).

Backup policy draft (quick):
- Daily incremental backups, weekly full snapshot (retention 90 days for snapshots, 365 days for metadata logs).
- Backups encrypted at rest with KMS-managed keys; key rotation annually or on compromise.
- Restore drill: quarterly test with SRE; document results and attach logs.
- TODO: confirm RPO/RTO numbers with SRE (JIRA: SRE-restore-2026).

Open items / blockers:
- Need infra to confirm whether offsite backups replicate to EU region (for customers with EU data). Contact: @mike-sato in slack #infra-ops.
- Maya to finish firewall rule export so I can attach to evidence (Maya ETA: 2026-03-06).
- Legal needs the vendor DPA before we mark LogStream as approved. Add to vendor pipeline.

Quick links / refs:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.company/display/SEC/SSO+Evidence+Templates
- Jira: SEC-142 (auditor question backlog), SRE-restore-2026
- Slack: #sec-compliance thread: "LogStream vendor q" (ts: 2026-03-02 11:14)
- Vendor questionnaire: /shared/secure/vendors/logstream/questionnaire-2026-03-02.pdf

Daily log (short):
- 09:15 - review LogStream questionnaire, flagged 6 items for legal/infra
- 10:00 - uploaded Okta screenshots to evidence bucket (evidence/okta/2026-03-03)
- 11:30 - quick sync with Maya on firewall export (action: Maya will export rules by 3/6)
- 13:00 - drafted backup policy answers, need SRE confirmation

Random notes to self:
- Remember to attach auditor Q responses to the SEC-142 ticket so auditors can reference them directly.
- When sending vendor questionnaire back, include a short cover email summarizing unresolved items and timeline.

Questions for tomorrow:
- Can we get a quick confirm from infra whether KMS keys are customer-scoped or global? If customer-scoped, note in evidence.
- Is there a standard naming convention for evidence files? (I think we use service_component_date_user)

-- Ethan
